# eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets (Data Source)

Retrieves the list of S3 buckets available to an AWS restore account. Use this data source to select a destination bucket for `eon_restore_job` S3 restores.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List S3 buckets available to an AWS restore account
data "eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets" "demo" {
  restore_account_id = "e696c7f0-17c6-4d9b-b589-591293c00d36"
}

output "s3_bucket_names" {
  description = "Names of the S3 buckets available for restore"
  value       = [for b in data.eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets.demo.buckets : b.bucket_name]
}

output "first_bucket_name" {
  description = "First listed S3 bucket name, usable as an eon_restore_job destination"
  value       = try(data.eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets.demo.buckets[0].bucket_name, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the AWS restore account whose S3 buckets are listed.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) List of S3 buckets available to the restore account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the S3 bucket.
- `region_name` (String) Region the S3 bucket is located in.
